lines.say: In ancient Egypt, people believed your heart would be weighed against a feather!
This idea comes from the Book of the Dead, more than three thousand years ago.
Egyptians believed that after death, your heart remembered everything good and bad you did.
The heart was placed on a scale, against the feather of Maat, the goddess of truth and justice.
If the heart was as light as the feather, you could go on to a happy afterlife.
The jackal-headed god Anubis watched the scale, and Thoth, the god of writing, wrote down the result.
Would your heart be as light as a feather? Tell me in the comments!
